title: 第11章 命运的指引第12章 夜晚的不速之客
slug: 南疆炼蛊三十载世人敬我如敬神
content_zh:
李元不会耍刀，更不会用剑。
刀剑蛊的作用，就类似于让他获得类似于前世小说中‘六脉神剑’一样的手段。
看起来很帅，实则弱鸡。
【选定原始材料】
【三转残蛊追风蝶，三转残蛊春蝉，三转残蛊飞影虫。
“合成。”
【正在合成——】
【你获得了三转凡蛊，无影蝉，已自动收服。
【无影蝉，炼化为本命蛊后，可大幅度提升蛊师的速度，炼化为从属蛊，则能发出暗影迷惑目标。
【是否炼化为本命蛊？】
“还是差了点。”
李元不满意。
要是能合出一只异蛊榜上有名的蛊虫该有多爽。
但他也知道，原始材料太垃圾，是不可能合出异蛊的。
“继续炼！”
【选定原始材料……】
……
半月后。
李元排列组合将三楼的蛊虫炼了一个遍，还是未能得偿所愿。
失败总是贯穿蛊师的始终。

“再熬一熬。”
他有的是时间。
“李元！
李元小子！”
这时，残蛊楼外的竹林小路上传来苍老的呼声。
“老王回来了？”
李元一喜。
说实在的，虽然他每日沉浸在合成蛊虫的摸奖之乐中，但偶尔还是会空虚，会想念老王。
迎出门去。
视线中，有一老一少穿过竹林而来。
老王不仅回来了，还带了一个与他年纪相仿的小姑娘回来。
“李元，给你介绍一下，这是我孙女，名叫王昭昭。”
“孙女？”
李元惊讶，“老王，还真被你找到命运的指引了？”
“那是。”
王邻开怀大笑，“老天爷待我总归不是那么残酷呢。”
“恭喜恭喜。”
李元由衷为老王高兴。
在这乱世之中，人命如草芥，你我皆浮萍，十六的逃亡生涯让他明白，与亲人间的久别重逢是怎样一种幸福。
content_en:
Li Yuan doesn't know how to wield a knife, let alone use a sword.
The function of Sword Gu is similar to allowing him to obtain a method similar to the 'Six Meridians Divine Sword' in the previous life novel.
He looks handsome, but is actually weak.
[Selected original materials]
[The third-level residual Gu is the chasing wind butterfly, the third-level residual Gu is the spring cicada, the third-level residual Gu is the flying shadow insect.
"Synthesis."
[Synthesizing——]
[You have obtained the third-level mortal Gu, Shadowless Cicada, and you have automatically conquered it.
[Shadowless Cicada, after being refined into the natal Gu, can greatly increase the speed of the Gu master, and when refined into the subordinate Gu, it can emit shadows to confuse the target.
[Is it to be refined into natal Gu? 】
"It's still a little bit worse."
Li Yuan was not satisfied.
How cool it would be if we could combine to create a famous Gu insect on the strange Gu list.
But he also knew that the original materials were too rubbish and it was impossible to combine them to create a strange Gu.
"Keep practicing!"
[Selected original materials...]
…
Half a month later.
Li Yuan used various combinations to refine the Gu insects on the third floor, but still failed to get what he wanted.
Failure always runs through the life of a Gu Master.
"Stay through it a little longer."
He has plenty of time.
"Li Yuan!
Li Yuan boy! "
At this time, an old voice came from the bamboo forest path outside Cangu Tower.
"Lao Wang is back?"
Li Yuanyi was delighted.
To be honest, although he was immersed in the joy of drawing prizes from synthetic Gu insects every day, he still felt empty occasionally and missed Lao Wang.
Welcome out the door.
In sight, an old man and a young man came through the bamboo forest.
Not only did Lao Wang come back, he also brought back a little girl about his age.
"Li Yuan, let me introduce you. This is my granddaughter, her name is Wang Zhaozhao."
"Granddaughter?"
Li Yuan was surprised, "Old Wang, have you really found the guidance of your destiny?"
"That is."
Wang Lin laughed heartily, "God is not so cruel to me after all."
"Congratulations."
Li Yuan was sincerely happy for Lao Wang.
In this troubled world, human life is like grass, and you and I are like duckweeds. Shiliu's escape life made him understand what kind of happiness it is to reunite with relatives after a long absence.
